claims.object_text: Ras-GAP protein enriched at excitatory synapses
claims.quote: SYNGAP1 is a key Ras-GAP protein enriched at excitatory synapses

claims.object_text: negative regulator of G-protein signaling through its GAP enzymatic activity
claims.quote: negative regulator of G-protein signaling through its GAP enzymatic activity

claims.object_text: structural role through interaction with postsynaptic density proteins
claims.quote: SYNGAP1 plays an important structural role through its interaction with postsynaptic density proteins

claims.object_text: intrinsic excitability (lower input resistance, increased rheobase)
claims.quote: Cortical excitatory neurons in heterozygous KO mice displayed reduced intrinsic excitability, including lower input resistance, and increased rheobase, a phenotype recapitulated in GAP-deficient Syngap1 mutants.

claims.object_text: seizure severity and susceptibility to PTZ-induced seizures
claims.quote: seizure severity and susceptibility to pentylenetetrazol (PTZ)-induced seizures were significantly elevated in heterozygous KO mice but unaffected in GAP-deficient mutants, implicating the structural rather than enzymatic role of Syngap1 in seizure regulation.

claims.object_text: structural role in seizure regulation (vs enzymatic)
